Overwrite facility types for matching rows

Source: R/filter_care_setting.R
apply_type_correction.Rd

Internal helper shared by filter_care_setting()'s facility ID, facility name, and regex correction blocks. Overwrites the facility type column with fix_to for the rows selected by mask, leaving other rows unchanged.

Usage

apply_type_correction(data, type_col_str, mask, fix_to)

Arguments

data

A data frame.

type_col_str

Name of the facility type column in data.

mask

Logical vector, one element per row: which rows to correct.

fix_to

The facility type value to write.

Value

data with type_col_str updated.
